dr.c dr_level: C3 detect and retry, user decision Q142 (full detect-and-retry); 0 = off (default, the unchanged code paths: no extra sync, allreduce or allocation); 1 = a P24 piece of the mn tier with a CRT flag (or a received limb >= 10^18 under P24_CHECK) is decided collectively before its result leaves the PEs and repeated once with the transform cache off (rns_dist.c mn_core); 2 = + the tree products' residue identity (rns_dist.c rns_mul_dist_mn_chk: R(C) = R(A) R(B) + R(X) modulo t1_q[0] from tracked residues held in mn.c, a repeat of the product, a stored share changed since production = fatal naming node and APU; the delivery fatals of a checked product become fail bits) and the leaf check (mn.c: the leaf's residues against the node's recurrence, ecalc.c pq_bg_run; the tree's tracked P, Q against the division's own residues); 3 = + the division checks (newton_db.c mn_dkm_low_d: A' = X Q + R of each low product X Q mod B^w as residues modulo t1_q[0], 0 or +-B^w, a mismatch recomputes the product once; the wrap's Rc likewise, a mismatch there is fatal; rns_dist.c rns_mul_dist_mn_cyc_v: the flagless cyclic product modulo B+1 and B-1, a mismatch recomputes it once); a second failure of the same piece or more than ECALC_DR_TOTAL failed pieces stops the run with the location and the PEs; forces the all-shift CRT flag (P24_CRT_ANY=0 is overridden)
dr.c dr_total_cap: the most failed pieces (collective events) a run survives under ECALC_DR before it stops

rns_dist.c p24_crt_any: the P24 CRT flag (c >= 10^60) covers every shift class s = 0, 6, 12 and the spill; default 1 since Q130 (2026-10-27), =0 kept fallback (the old s = 12 + spill flag; P24_CHECK >= 1 still adds the all-shift flag)
